saints.name: St. Macrina the Younger
saints.title: Virgin
saints.shortBlurb: The elder sister who formed a household of saints and guided the great Cappadocian Fathers…
biography: Macrina was the eldest child of a remarkable Christian family of Cappadocia, granddaughter of Macrina the Elder and sister of St. Basil the Great, St. Gregory of Nyssa, and St. Peter of Sebaste. After the death of the man to whom she had been betrothed, she resolved to remain a virgin and devoted herself to prayer and asceticism.

She turned the family estate at Annesi into a monastic community and, by her example and counsel, drew her brothers toward holiness and the service of the Church. Her brother Gregory has left a moving account of her holy death in 379 in his Life of Macrina.
saints.knownFor: Forming the household of the Cappadocian Fathers in holiness.
